title: TransportOffer
description: A carrier's commercial offer to transport goods, written to the carrier's eVault, either in answer to a ShipmentRequest or published generally. The offer belongs to the carrier; discovery services only find it. Closest schema.org type: Offer. A sender accepts an offer with a Relation (subject: the ShipmentRequest, predicate 'acceptedOffer', object: this offer). Ratings of the carrier use the existing Reference schema.

authorId.description: eName of whoever issued the offer on the carrier's behalf (a person or the carrier's platform)

offeredBy.description: eName of the carrier organisation that is bound by the offer (schema.org: offeredBy)

localLabel.description: Human-readable label used by the carrier

inResponseTo.description: The ShipmentRequest this offer answers, as w3ds://envelope?id=@<ename>/<metaEnvelopeId>. Absent for a generally published offer.

priceType.description: 'fixed': the customer price does not change when execution costs change; 'estimate': it may

serviceScope.description: Part of the journey the carrier is responsible for

preferredDeliveryDays.description: Offered preferred delivery time, in days from pickup

latestDeliveryDays.description: Offered latest delivery time, in days from pickup

validThrough.description: Until when the offer can be accepted (schema.org: validThrough)

terms.description: Short summary of commercial terms, or a w3ds://file URI of the full terms

updatedAt.description: When the record was last updated
